17	package org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.audit;
18	
19	import org.slf4j.Logger;
20	import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
21	import org.springframework.samples.petclinic.model.Owner;
22	import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;
23	
24	/**
25	 * Emits audit trail entries for owner lifecycle events on the dedicated {@code AUDIT} logger,
26	 * keeping audit side-effects out of the request-handling flow.
27	 */
28	@Component
29	public class OwnerAuditLogger {
30	
31	    private static final Logger AUDIT = LoggerFactory.getLogger("AUDIT");
32	
33	    /**
34	     * Record that an owner was successfully created, capturing the assigned id, customer code,
35	     * resolved registration date and membership level.
36	     *
37	     * @param owner the owner that has just been persisted
38	     */
39	    public void created(Owner owner) {
40	        AUDIT.info("owner created id={} customerCode={} registrationDate={} membershipLevel={}",
41	            owner.getId(), owner.getCustomerCode(), owner.getRegistrationDate(), owner.getMembershipLevel());
42	    }
43	}
